modelName: Milky Way differential circular-rotation inspection model
observationEpoch: Source-native epochs; Gaia bridge J2016.0; structural reconstruction is static

rotationCurve.systematicUncertainty: approximately 2–5 percent; slope systematic uncertainty 0.46 km/s/kpc
rotationCurve.interpretation: Axisymmetric circular-velocity reconstruction used only where 5 <= R <= 25 kpc. The inner barred region is excluded.

catalogLinearPropagation.missingRadialVelocityPolicy: static; insufficient 3D velocity data; never substitute zero

componentPolicies.sun: model-integrated circular orbit within the adopted rotation curve
componentPolicies.hmsfr: model-integrated circular orbit where Galactocentric radius is inside the adopted curve; source astrometry remains preserved
componentPolicies.nearbyCatalogStar: Gaia uniform rectilinear catalog propagation only when full 6D inputs exist, capped at plus/minus 1 Myr; otherwise static
componentPolicies.thinDiskRepresentative: model-integrated differential circular rotation where supported
componentPolicies.thickDiskRepresentative: model-integrated differential circular rotation where supported
componentPolicies.armPopulationRepresentative: model-integrated differential circular rotation where supported; static arm reconstruction guides remain separate
componentPolicies.bar: static; no pattern-speed model adopted in this release
componentPolicies.bulge: static; no pattern-speed model adopted in this release
componentPolicies.stellarHalo: static; never rigidly rotated with the disk
componentPolicies.spiralArmReconstruction: static observation-derived reconstruction guide; not a material stellar orbit
componentPolicies.lmcSmc: static catalog anchors; never attached to disk rotation

knownLimitations: This is a dynamical reconstruction for scientific inspection, not an exact future prediction.
The axisymmetric circular model excludes R < 5 kpc because the Galactic bar requires a non-axisymmetric model.
Circular motion omits eccentricity, radial migration, vertical oscillation, spiral transients and interactions.
Gaia rectilinear propagation is capped at 1 Myr and does not become a Galactic orbit integration.
HMSFR VLSR values are preserved but are not silently treated as complete Galactocentric 3D velocities.
No bar pattern speed, halo rotation, spiral-pattern evolution or Magellanic orbital integration is implemented.
